paragraphs.chinese:
这一集发生在平安夜，三个家庭都在为“圣诞节到底应该怎么过”折腾。

在 Dunphy 家，Claire 发现沙发上有一块烧焦的痕迹，看起来像是香烟烫出来的。三个孩子谁都不承认抽过烟，于是 Phil 放出狠话：没人说实话，圣诞节就取消。他和 Claire 真把圣诞树和装饰都拆了下来，就等着哪个孩子先扛不住。

孩子们也想了个办法。先让 Luke 认错，然后 Haley 和 Alex 也跟着说是自己干的，希望爸妈看到三个人这么讲义气，一感动就把圣诞节恢复了。Luke 照计划认了，可两个姐姐根本没跟上，直接把他晾在那里。Luke 赶紧收回口供，Phil 也死活不肯让步。

后来 Alex 下楼，说抽烟的人就是自己。她告诉 Phil，想怎么罚她都行，但别因为她一个人让全家都没圣诞节。于是装饰重新挂了起来，Alex 也被禁足。可没过多久，阳光穿过一个玻璃挂饰，居然在沙发上一模一样的位置又烧出了痕迹。原来根本没人抽烟。Alex 只是为了保住圣诞节才主动背锅。Claire 和 Phil 这才发现，他们为了一个根本没人犯过的错，把三个孩子全罚了一遍。Claire 最后只好答应带全家去意大利旅行作为补偿。

与此同时，Jay 一心想把圣诞节过成 Claire 和 Mitchell 小时候的样子：穿新睡衣、在楼梯上拍全家福、早上再拆礼物，一套流程都不能少。Gloria 和 Manny 也想加点哥伦比亚传统，比如半夜拆礼物、放烟花，还有互相恶作剧。可 Jay 一直不当回事，因为他只想按自己的方式过。

和 Cameron 聊过之后，Jay 才意识到，有了新的家庭，就应该一起创造新的回忆，而不是硬把过去的圣诞节复制一遍。Gloria 也跟 Manny 解释了，为什么那些老传统对 Jay 那么重要。最后双方都让了一步。Jay 买回了哥伦比亚传统食物，然后故意板着脸说，以后在美国不许再搞任何哥伦比亚传统，把 Gloria 和 Manny 骗得一愣一愣的。等两个人真信了，他才大喊一声“Inocente!”——原来是在恶作剧，而且连烟花都给他们准备好了。

Mitchell 和 Cameron 带 Lily 去商场见圣诞老人，可他们嫌那个 Santa 太瘦，结果把人家的工作都投诉没了。两个人心里过意不去，就把他请回家吃晚饭，却一直没承认害他被开除的就是他们。

后来，Cameron 以前参加的圣诞颂歌团正好跑到他们家门外唱歌。那群人之前把 Cameron 踢出了团，他气得准备直接打开喷水器赶人。前 Santa Scott 劝他算了，原谅别人感觉更好。Cameron 还真忍住了，结果其中一个人反过来嘲讽他。Scott 当场一拳揍了过去。

到最后，谁都没过成自己原本计划好的圣诞节。但真正会被记住的，反而就是这些乱七八糟的意外。
paragraphs.english:
This episode takes place on Christmas Eve, and all three families are arguing about what Christmas is supposed to look like.

At the Dunphy house, Claire finds a burn mark on the couch that looks like it came from a cigarette. None of the kids admits to smoking, so Phil makes a huge threat: if nobody tells the truth, Christmas is canceled. He and Claire take down the tree and decorations, expecting one of the kids to crack.

The kids come up with their own plan. Luke is supposed to confess, and then Haley and Alex will both claim they did it too, hoping their parents will be so touched by their loyalty that they bring Christmas back. Luke does his part, but his sisters leave him hanging. He quickly takes the confession back, and Phil refuses to give in.

Later, Alex comes downstairs and says she was the one smoking. She tells Phil he can punish her, but she doesn’t want everyone else to lose Christmas. The decorations go back up, and Alex gets grounded. Then sunlight shines through a glass ornament and starts burning the couch in exactly the same spot. Nobody smoked at all. Alex only took the blame to save Christmas, and Claire and Phil realize they punished the kids for something none of them did. Claire ends up promising a family trip to Italy to make up for it.

Meanwhile, Jay is determined to have the same Christmas he had when Claire and Mitchell were young: new pajamas, a family picture on the stairs, presents in the morning, the whole routine. Gloria and Manny want some of their Colombian traditions too, like opening presents at midnight, setting off fireworks, and playing practical jokes. Jay keeps brushing them off because he wants Christmas done his way.

After talking to Cameron, Jay realizes that having a new family means making new memories instead of trying to recreate the old ones. Gloria also explains to Manny why Jay cares so much about those traditions. In the end, both sides make an effort. Jay brings home Colombian food, then pretends he’s banning all Colombian traditions just to fool Gloria and Manny. Once they fall for it, he shouts “Inocente!” and reveals that he even found fireworks.

Mitchell and Cameron take Lily to see Santa at the mall, but they complain that the Santa is too thin and end up getting him fired. Feeling guilty, they invite him home for dinner without admitting they caused the problem.

Later, Cameron’s old caroling group shows up outside. They kicked him out, and Cameron is ready to turn the sprinklers on them. Scott, the former Santa, talks him into forgiving them. Cameron tries, but one of the singers insults him anyway. Scott immediately punches the guy.

By the end, nobody gets the Christmas they originally planned, but the strange, messy parts are exactly what they’ll remember.
